title: $100 a month into the Nasdaq 100 since 1999 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into the Nasdaq 100 since 1999.
Today that would be worth about {dca:QQQ:1999-03-10} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: the Nasdaq 100 price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
